info.title: Isengard API
info.description: Isengard REST API — the projects and albums you can see, the studies they hold, albums and sub-albums for your results, the copy of series between the albums of a project, the DICOMweb tokens and the members of your albums. Every call needs ``Authorization: Bearer <your-personal-token>`` (401 without it). An application that signs its users in with Isengard (OpenID Connect, ``/o/``) sends their access token instead, limited by its scopes: ``albums:read``, ``albums:write`` (albums, sub-albums, copies), ``album-tokens:write``, ``album-members:write``.

get.description:
Return the projects visible to the caller, ordered by name, each with the albums of it the caller sees.

The list is paginated with ``limit`` and ``offset``; ``count`` is the total number of visible projects.
Return a single project, provided it is visible to the caller, with the albums of it the caller sees.

post.description:
Create a root album in the project, as the project page's "New album" button.

Requires a token (an access token: with the ``albums:write`` scope) and to administer the project: one of its stewards,
or a superuser. The caller becomes the steward of the album (a superuser who is not a steward of the project creates it
without steward). A name already used in the project answers 409. To create a sub-album, see
``POST /albums/{album_id}/sub-albums/``.

get.description:
Return the albums visible to the caller, ordered by name.

``project`` narrows the list to the albums of that project. ``permission``, repeatable, narrows it to the albums
where the caller holds every permission given (e.g. ``?permission=can_upload&permission=can_create_token``).
``keyword`` narrows it to the albums with that keyword, whatever its case.
The list is paginated with ``limit`` and ``offset``; ``count`` is the total number of visible albums.
Return the detail of a single album, provided it is visible to the caller.

patch.summary: Change the details of an album
patch.description:
Change the details of the album: those sent, the others kept, as the details form of its settings page.

Requires a token (an access token: with the ``albums:write`` scope) and to administer the album: one of its stewards, a
steward of its project or a superuser. ``keywords`` replaces all the keywords. A name already used in the project
answers 409. A frozen album keeps the Snapshot category. The stewards and the members are not details: see
``/albums/{album_id}/members/``.

get.description:
Return the studies the album shows, with the filters of its page, ordered by patient ID, latest first.

``patient_id`` and ``description`` match a part of the field; every word of ``patient_name`` must appear (``john doe``
matches ``DOE^JOHN``); ``date_from`` and ``date_to`` bound the study date; ``modality``, repeatable, keeps the studies
with a series of one of these modalities; ``own`` keeps a sub-album's own series, without those of its parent albums.
Each study gives the modalities and the number of its series the album shows. The album must be visible to the caller.
The list is paginated with ``limit`` and ``offset``; ``count`` is the number of matching studies.

Return the series the album shows, ordered by UID: its own and, for a sub-album, those of its parent albums the caller sees.

``modality`` narrows the list to the series of that modality (e.g. ``CT``).
``inherited`` is true for a series shown from a parent album, that the album does not hold itself.
The album must be visible to the caller (public or the user is a member/steward).
The list is paginated with ``limit`` and ``offset``; ``count`` is the total number of series the album shows.

get.summary: List series of a study of an album
get.description:
Return the series of the study (by its StudyInstanceUID) that the album shows, ordered by modality, description and UID.

``own`` keeps a sub-album's own series, without those of its parent albums, as the album page's filter. ``inherited``
is true for a series shown from a parent album. The album must be visible to the caller, and show at least one series
of the study: else 404.

post.description:
Create a sub-album of the album, in its project, e.g. to receive the results of an algorithm run on the album's series.

Requires a token (an access token: with the ``albums:write`` scope) and ``can_create_subalbum`` on the album, as the album page's "New sub-album" button. The
caller becomes the steward of the sub-album, which shows the series of its parent albums next to its own. A name
already used in the project answers 409: list the albums of the project to reuse it. Then create a token of the
sub-album (``POST /albums/{album_id}/tokens/``) to store the results through DICOMweb STOW-RS.

post.summary: Copy series to another album of the project
post.description:
Copy series the album shows into ``destination``, another album of the same project, as the album page's "Copy" button.

``series`` lists their SeriesInstanceUIDs (``GET /albums/{album_id}/series/``), 1000 at most per call. Requires a token (an
access token: with the ``albums:write`` scope), ``can_copy_data`` on the album and ``can_upload`` on the destination, which
a frozen album never grants: ``GET /albums/?project={project_id}&permission=can_upload`` lists the possible destinations.
A series the album does not show answers 404, and nothing is copied. A series the album inherits from a parent album
also requires ``can_copy_data`` on a parent album holding it: without it, it is left out (``not_permitted``). A series a
parent album of the destination holds is already shown by the destination, and is not copied (``already_shown``).
Copying again is harmless: what the destination holds is listed in ``already_held``.

The copy links the series to the destination in Isengard: nothing is copied in Orthanc, nor removed from the album.

post.summary: Duplicate an album into a new album of its project
post.description:
Duplicate the album into a new album of its project, as the album page's "Duplicate" button.

Requires a token (an access token: with the ``albums:write`` scope) and to administer the project: one of its stewards,
or a superuser; anyone else who sees the album gets 403. ``mode`` says what the copy holds:
``album`` (the default) its own series (all of a root album; a sub-album's own data, without what it inherits);
``merged`` a sub-album's series and those it inherits from its parent albums, in one root album;
``lineage`` the same tree: a copy of each parent album, root first, then the copy of the sub-album under them, each
holding the series of its original. ``merged`` and ``lineage`` on a root album answer 422.

Each copy takes the description, keywords, licence, reference, contact and category of its original; ``category``
changes the copy's, and is required for a frozen album, whose copy is a live album. The rights are never copied: no
member, steward or token; every copy is private and the caller becomes its steward (a superuser who is not a member
of the project creates it without steward). ``parent_names`` names the copies of the parent albums (by their
``album_id``); the others are named "<name> (copy)". A name already used in the project answers 409, and nothing
is created. The copies link the album's series in Isengard: nothing is copied in Orthanc.

get.description:
Return the DICOMweb tokens of the album, latest first, as its token page: the active ones, and with ``inactive``
the expired and revoked ones too. Never their value, which is not stored.

Requires a token (an access token: with the ``album-tokens:write`` scope) and ``can_create_token`` on the album.
The list is paginated with ``limit`` and ``offset``.

post.description:
Create a DICOMweb token of the album and return it with its raw value, shown this once only.

Requires a token (an access token: with the ``album-tokens:write`` scope) and ``can_create_token`` on the album.
Reading through a token of a sub-album also requires ``can_download`` on the parent albums the caller sees.

delete.description:
Revoke a DICOMweb token of the album: it stops authenticating at once. Revoking it again changes nothing.

Requires a token (an access token: with the ``album-tokens:write`` scope) and ``can_create_token`` on the album,
like the album's token page.

get.summary: List the members of an album
get.description:
Return the access table of the album: its stewards, who hold every permission, then its members with their
permissions, then the group memberships kept from before groups were set aside.

Requires ``can_manage_members`` on the album, as its settings page. The stewards of the project, who administer every
album of it, are listed by the project's settings page.

post.summary: Add a member to an album
post.description:
Make a user (by username or email address) a member of the album, with ``permissions``.

Requires a token (an access token: with the ``album-members:write`` scope) and ``can_manage_members`` on the album. The
user must already be a member of the project, or of the parent album for a sub-album (422). Whoever does not
administer the album only grants the permissions they hold (403). A steward, or a member already, answers 409: change
a member's permissions with ``PATCH /albums/{album_id}/members/{user_id}/``. No one holds ``can_upload`` and
``can_remove`` on a frozen album (422).

patch.summary: Grant and revoke permissions of a member
patch.description:
Grant the permissions of ``grant`` and revoke those of ``revoke`` to a member of the album; the others are kept.

Requires a token (an access token: with the ``album-members:write`` scope) and ``can_manage_members`` on the album.
Whoever does not administer the album only grants or revokes the permissions they hold (403). A user who is not a
member answers 422, a steward 409: a steward holds every permission. A member without any permission left still sees
the album, until removed with ``DELETE /albums/{album_id}/members/{user_id}/``.

delete.summary: Remove a member from an album
delete.description:
Remove a member from the album and from its sub-albums, as the trash of the album's settings page.

Requires a token (an access token: with the ``album-members:write`` scope) and ``can_manage_members`` on the album,
whatever the permissions of the member. A user who is not a member answers 404, a steward 409: the stewards are
changed on the settings page. The member keeps what they see otherwise (a public album, the project's other albums);
the album tokens they created follow their access on every request.

delete.summary: Revoke the album token of the call
delete.description:
Revoke the album token sent in ``Authorization: Bearer <album token>``: its holder gives it up once done with it.

Needs no user's token: an application revokes the album token it was given (e.g. once the jobs that write with it
have ended). An already revoked or expired token answers 204 too; an unknown one, 401.

get.description:
Return the studies of the albums the caller sees matching ``q``, at most ``limit``.

Every word of ``q`` must appear, case-insensitively, in the patient ID, the patient name, the study description or the
accession number; ``^`` separates words like a space, so ``john doe`` matches ``DOE^JOHN``. Studies are ordered by
patient ID, latest first. Each study lists its modalities and the albums the caller sees that hold one of its series.
``modality``, repeatable, keeps the studies with a series of one of these modalities in an album the caller sees;
``date_from`` and ``date_to`` bound the study date. ``has_more`` is true when more studies match: refine ``q`` rather
than paging.

Return the user the token acts for, and the token: a personal token, or the access token of an application with its
scopes. Projects and albums are listed by ``/projects/`` and ``/albums/``, with the caller's permissions as filters.

ProjectAlbumOut.description: An album as listed in its project; ``GET /albums/{album_id}/`` gives the whole of it.
ProjectAlbumOut.title: ProjectAlbumOut

AlbumIn.description: A root album to create in a project: its name is unique in the project. The other details are optional.
AlbumIn.title: AlbumIn

AlbumPatchIn.description: The details of an album to change: the fields left out are kept. ``keywords`` replaces all of them.
AlbumPatchIn.title: AlbumPatchIn

SubAlbumIn.description: A sub-album to create: its name is unique in the project.
SubAlbumIn.title: SubAlbumIn

SeriesCopyOut.description: What the copy did with each requested series (SeriesInstanceUIDs, ordered).
SeriesCopyOut.title: SeriesCopyOut

SeriesCopyIn.description: Series of the album to copy into another album of its project, by SeriesInstanceUID.
SeriesCopyIn.title: SeriesCopyIn

AlbumDuplicateIn.description: How to duplicate an album into a new album of its project, and the name of its copy, unique in the project.
AlbumDuplicateIn.title: AlbumDuplicateIn

ListedAlbumTokenOut.description: A token of the album, as its token page lists it: never its value, which is not stored.
ListedAlbumTokenOut.title: ListedAlbumTokenOut

AlbumTokenIn.description: A DICOMweb token of the album, with at least one of ``can_read`` and ``can_write``.
AlbumTokenIn.title: AlbumTokenIn

MemberOut.description: A row of the album's access table: a steward, a member, or a group membership kept from before groups were set aside.
MemberOut.title: MemberOut

MemberIn.description: A new member of the album: a member of the project, or of the parent album for a sub-album.
MemberIn.title: MemberIn

MemberPermissionsIn.description: Permissions of a member to grant and to revoke; the others are kept.
MemberPermissionsIn.title: MemberPermissionsIn

StudyAlbumOut.description: An album the caller sees that holds a series of the study.
StudyAlbumOut.title: StudyAlbumOut

MeOut.description: The user of the token, and the token.
MeOut.title: MeOut
